## About

Gaurav Mishra is a final-year CS Engineering student and full stack developer based in New Delhi, India. He builds and ships complete web applications from database schema to deployed UI, using Java/Spring Boot on the backend and React/Next.js on the frontend. He has integrated LLM APIs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into production features, containerised services with Docker, and secured applications with JWT authentication. He is currently seeking SDE internship and full-time opportunities.

## Projects

### Flapboard - AI-Powered Adaptive Typing Platform (2026)
AI-powered adaptive typing platform that tracks real-time WPM and accuracy, provides a performance dashboard, and generates targeted drills from past weaknesses. Built a Spring Boot REST API with JWT authentication and PostgreSQL for user accounts, typing sessions, and progress history; containerised the backend with Docker. Integrated a live LLM API that structures performance metrics into personalised coaching.
Technologies: Spring Boot, Java, Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, JWT
URL: https://typing-master-pied.vercel.app

### Golf Cart - Full-Stack Fundraising Platform (2026)
Role-based full-stack fundraising platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL (Neon), Prisma, Razorpay, and Zod. Implemented organisation registration with document upload and admin verification workflow, plus campaign management and donation tracking. Added AI-assisted campaign writing and search with Zod-validated structured outputs.
Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Razorpay, Zod

### HireTrack - Recruitment Management Platform / ATS (2026)
Applicant Tracking System built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Auth.js, bcrypt, and shadcn/ui. Credentials-based authentication with bcrypt password hashing and protected dashboard routes. Per-application hiring stages: Applied, Screening, Interview, Offer, Hired/Rejected.
Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Auth.js, shadcn/ui
URL: https://github.com/Gaurav18071/Hiretrack-ai
